svg.title: Same illustrative power law on ordinary and log-log axes
svg.desc: The three models have 1M, 10M and 100M parameters and losses 4.000, 3.464 and 3.000. The ordinary-axis plot is curved. On log-log axes both size jumps and both proportional loss drops have equal spacing, producing a straight line. Loss axes are restricted to 2.87 through 4.18.

g.text: Illustrative power law: loss falls by 13.4% for each ×10 in model size.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #475467

g.text: Dots follow the invented pattern in section 1; this is not Kaplan measurement data.

g.text: Loss axes show 2.87–4.18 so the shape is visible; neither panel begins at zero.
